The majority of people are bi sexual, not straight or gay. However, they may identify as gay, straight, lesbian, etc these are just labels.

The poll is essentially meaningless because it is based on pure speculation by people who likely have not even considered the question or reviewed any data on the topic to make an accurate estimate. It is similar to asking "Just your best guess, how many americans brush their teeth every morning" and then arguing that the more americans are brushing their teeth in the morning because of the influence of all the toothbrush commercials.
